plan_a:
Mono-White Death & Taxes: deploy taxing hatebears (Thalia, Mother of Runes, Phyrexian Revoker) and grind on tempo. Lock their mana with Rishadan Port + Wasteland, protect creatures with Mother of Runes, and suit up a threat with Stoneforge Mystic -> Batterskull/Jitte. Swords to Plowshares removes their threats. Attrition and mana-denial win; don't race combo, disrupt it.
YOUR DECKLIST (you know your own deck's contents; only the draw order is hidden): 4x Aether Vial, 1x Batterskull, 2x Cavern of Souls, 4x Flickerwisp, 1x Karakas, 2x Mirran Crusader, 4x Mother of Runes, 2x Palace Jailer, 2x Phyrexian Revoker, 16x Plains, 3x Recruiter of the Guard, 4x Rishadan Port, 2x Stoneforge Mystic, 4x Swords to Plowshares, 4x Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, 1x Umezawa's Jitte, 4x Wasteland
YOUR CARDS (what each card in your deck does):
  Aether Vial {1} — At the beginning of your upkeep, you may put a charge counter on Aether Vial.\n{T}: You may put a creature card with mana value equal to the number of charge counters on Aether Vial from your hand onto the battlefield.
  Batterskull {5} — Living weapon (When this Equipment enters, create a 0/0 black Phyrexian Germ creature token, then attach this to it.)\nEquipped creature gets +4/+4 and has vigilance and lifelink.\n{3}: Return Batterskull to its owner's hand.\nEquip {5}

  Flickerwisp {1}{W}{W} — Flying\nWhen Flickerwisp enters, exile another target permanent. Return that card to the battlefield under its owner's control at the beginning of the next end step.
  Karakas no cost — {T}: Add {W}.\n{T}: Return target legendary creature to its owner's hand.
  Mirran Crusader {1}{W}{W} — Double strike, protection from black and from green
  Mother of Runes {W} — {T}: Target creature you control gains protection from the color of your choice until end of turn.
  Palace Jailer {2}{W}{W} — When Palace Jailer enters, you become the monarch.\nWhen Palace Jailer enters, exile target creature an opponent controls until an opponent becomes the monarch.
  Phyrexian Revoker {2} — As Phyrexian Revoker enters, choose a nonland card name.\nActivated abilities of sources with the chosen name can't be activated.
  Plains no cost — ({T}: Add {W}.)
  Recruiter of the Guard {2}{W} — When Recruiter of the Guard enters, you may search your library for a creature card with toughness 2 or less, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
  Rishadan Port no cost — {T}: Add {C}.\n{1}, {T}: Tap target land.

  Swords to Plowshares {W} — Exile target creature. Its controller gains life equal to its power.
  Thalia, Guardian of Thraben {1}{W} — First strike\nNoncreature spells cost {1} more to cast.

plan_b:
Izzet Delver tempo: land a cheap threat early (Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Murktide Regent), then protect it and race while denying their mana. Counter their key spells with Daze, Force of Will, Spell Pierce; burn their blockers and face with Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning; Wasteland their duals. You are the beatdown when ahead on board — count clock vs their outs before trading.
YOUR DECKLIST (you know your own deck's contents; only the draw order is hidden): 4x Brainstorm, 2x Chain Lightning, 4x Daze, 4x Delver of Secrets, 4x Dragon's Rage Channeler, 4x Flooded Strand, 1x Force of Negation, 4x Force of Will, 7x Island, 4x Lightning Bolt, 3x Murktide Regent, 4x Ponder, 1x Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, 4x Scalding Tarn, 2x Spell Pierce, 4x Volcanic Island, 4x Wasteland
YOUR CARDS (what each card in your deck does):
  Brainstorm {U} — Draw three cards, then put two cards from your hand on top of your library in any order.
  Chain Lightning {R} — Chain Lightning deals 3 damage to any target. Then that player or that permanent's controller may pay {R}{R}. If the player does, they may copy this spell and may choose a new target for that copy.
  Daze {1}{U} — You may return an Island you control to its owner's hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.\nCounter target spell unless its controller pays {1}.
  Delver of Secrets {U} — At the beginning of your upkeep, look at the top card of your library. You may reveal that card. If an instant or sorcery card is revealed this way, transform Delver of Secrets.
  Dragon's Rage Channeler {R} — Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put that card into your graveyard.)\nDelirium — As long as there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, Dragon's Rage Channeler gets +2/+2, has flying, and attacks each combat if able.
  Flooded Strand no cost — {T}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice Flooded Strand: Search your library for a Plains or Island card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
  Force of Negation {1}{U}{U} — If it's not your turn, you may exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.\nCounter target noncreature spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
  Force of Will {3}{U}{U} — You may pay 1 life and exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.\nCounter target spell.
  Island no cost — ({T}: Add {U}.)
  Lightning Bolt {R} — Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to any target.
  Murktide Regent {5}{U}{U} — Delve (Each card you exile from your graveyard while casting this spell pays for {1}.)\nFlying\nMurktide Regent enters with a +1/+1 counter on it for each instant and sorcery card exiled with it.\nWhenever an instant or sorcery card leaves your graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on Murktide Regent.
  Ponder {U} — Look at the top three cards of your library, then put them back in any order. You may shuffle.\nDraw a card.
  Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer {R} — Whenever Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer deals combat damage to a player, create a Treasure token and exile the top card of that player's library. Until end of turn, you may cast that card.\nDash {1}{R} (You may cast this spell for its dash cost. If you do, it gains haste, and it's returned from the battlefield to its owner's hand at the beginning of the next end step.)
  Scalding Tarn no cost — {T}, Pay 1 life, Sacrifice Scalding Tarn: Search your library for an Island or Mountain card, put it onto the battlefield, then shuffle.
  Spell Pierce {U} — Counter target noncreature spell unless its controller pays {2}.
  Volcanic Island no cost — ({T}: Add {U} or {R}.)
  Wasteland no cost — {T}: Add {C}.\n{T}, Sacrifice Wasteland: Destroy target nonbasic land.
